# Play { #anylumino.Play }

```python
Play(value=0, min=0, max=100, step=1, interval=100, disabled=False, **kwargs)
```

Playback stepper control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type     | Description                                      | Default   |
|----------|----------|--------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| value    | optional | Initial value and synced Python value.           | `0`       |
| min      | optional | Minimum numeric, date, or time value.            | `0`       |
| max      | optional | Maximum numeric, date, or time value.            | `100`     |
| step     | optional | Increment size.                                  | `1`       |
| interval | optional | Delay between play-widget ticks in milliseconds. | `100`     |
| disabled | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled.            | `False`   |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [control_kind](#anylumino.Play.control_kind) | A trait for unicode strings. |
| [rows](#anylumino.Play.rows) | An int trait. |
